subject.title: Add testing framework for cron jobs and skills (dry-run mode)

question: What no-side-effects contract should OpenClaw guarantee for cron and skills testing, and should it share request-scoped tool-interception semantics with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41418?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but implementation would define a public safety boundary and config/API behavior across cron, skills, tools, hooks, channel delivery, Gateway protocol, and external APIs.

options.title: Design one request-scoped contract
options.body: Define cron test/validate, skills test, and shared tool-interception semantics together so preview modes provide one consistent side-effect guarantee across runtime paths.

options.title: Ship cron validation first
options.body: Add only cron config, schedule, and delivery validation while leaving skill testing and global interception to separate maintainer decisions.

options.title: Defer broad dry-run semantics
options.body: Keep current command-specific dry-run surfaces until a maintainer sponsors the broader trusted preview boundary.

recommendation.title: Design one request-scoped contract
recommendation.body: Define cron test/validate, skills test, and shared tool-interception semantics together so preview modes provide one consistent side-effect guarantee across runtime paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from prior issue review plus feature-history ownership across cron, skills, and shared runtime surfaces.
